name: One Romantic Date, Hold the Awkward!
source:
You ask your skeleton crush on a date. And he says YES!

But then the panic sets in... What if you say the wrong thing? What if he realizes he doesn't like you?

Don't worry! Your friends are here to help! .... or maybe, that's the perfect reason to worry.

[From [url=https://derpychocho.itch.io/one-romantic-date-hold-the-awkward]Itch.io[/url]]
